slides.texte_overlay:
Underrated skills that will make
you unforgettable to her
Learn to plan a real date. Not "wanna chill?" Pick a place, book it, have a plan B if it rains. Being the guy who makes an evening easy is rare, and she'll tell her friends about it.
Learn to remember the small stuff. Her coffee order, her favorite song, her sister's name. Bring them up naturally. It shows you were listening when she thought you weren't paying attention.
Learn to make her laugh about your own mistakes. "Okay, I definitely missed the turn three times." Guys who laugh at themselves are relaxed to be around, and that ease is very attractive.
Learn to write her a real message. Not just emojis. One line about something you liked about the day. "That walk by the river was the best part of my week." Simple, honest, unforgettable.
Learn to cook her one great meal. Not fancy, just made with care. Candle, music, phone away. People remember the night someone cooked for them far longer than any expensive restaurant.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. You'll always have something new to share with her, and couples who keep learning together never get bored.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. You'll always have something new to share with her. Couples who keep learning never get bored.

slides.texte_overlay: Learn to show up for her people. Her friend's birthday, her dad's barbecue, her sister's move. Being good with the people she loves is one of the most memorable things you can do.
